name: TinyZKP Enterprise
summary: Reserved-capacity and procurement review path for teams putting TinyZKP proof receipts into production workflows.

offer.primary: Reserved proof receipt infrastructure without owning prover operations.
offer.entrypoint: One scoped proof-receipt pilot or one existing self-serve workflow that needs procurement, support, limits, or reserved capacity.
offer.commercial_model: $5,000 production pilot for one scoped workflow; sales-assisted platform rollout from $499/month minimum plus usage after review; custom reserved capacity after workflow fit, expected volume, trace size, verifier path, and support expectations are known.

best_fit: Customer-visible proof receipts attached to API mutations or SaaS workflows
Agent control planes that need receipts for high-value tool-call batches
Agent platforms, IDEs, workflow engines, and marketplaces that want proof receipts as a native policy surface
Finance, audit, reserve, liability, or reconciliation checkpoints
Long supported state-transition traces where Compute is preferable to self-hosted high-RAM prover operations

commercial_packages.name: Production Pilot
commercial_packages.commercial_model: $5,000 one-time scoped pilot, credited toward an annual or reserved-capacity agreement if converted within 60 days.
commercial_packages.best_for: One high-value workflow that needs a real receipt and verifier result before rollout.

commercial_packages.name: Platform Rollout
commercial_packages.commercial_model: From $499/month committed minimum plus usage after pilot or design review.
commercial_packages.best_for: Agent platforms, workflow engines, IDEs, and marketplaces exposing proof receipts as a native capability.

commercial_packages.name: Reserved Capacity
commercial_packages.commercial_model: Custom terms based on reserved workers, trace mix, support targets, and procurement needs.
commercial_packages.best_for: Customer-visible, auditor-visible, or operationally critical proof receipt workloads.

rollout.goal: Run one scoped pilot with success metrics, verifier path, data boundary, and cost estimate.
Attach receipts to one production-like workflow and route security/procurement review through the public packet.
Set reserved capacity, support targets, and commercial terms if the receipt becomes customer- or auditor-visible.
Expand to adjacent workflows only after receipt verification and incident ownership are operationally clear.

not_claimed_by_default: On-chain verifier support for every chain
Truth claims that are not encoded into the proven statement
Production support commitment before commercial terms are agreed
qualification_inputs: Workflow owner, verifier, and business decision the receipt supports
Expected monthly proof volume, trace-size range, and peak concurrency
Whether a $5,000 production pilot, platform rollout, or reserved-capacity path is the intended commercial route
Whether the receipt is internal, auditor-visible, customer-visible, or agent-supervisor visible
Security, privacy, legal, retention, invoice, and support requirements
